name: FormTxt
title: paginated and pageless documents with .docx round trips on your own machine
summary: FormTxt is an open, local-first word processor with real pages, a ribbon, .docx and .odt round trips, and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor editing through the same commands.
lede: FormTxt is an open, local-first alternative to Microsoft Word and Google Docs. It lays documents out on real pages or pageless, opens and saves .docx and .odt, and lets Claude Code, Codex or Cursor draft and edit live through the same commands a person uses.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux, in a browser or as a desktop app built with ./build_app
checks: Lays out real pages with headers, footers, section breaks, tables, pictures and a ruler, or switches to pageless.
Opens and saves .docx, .dotx, .odt, .rtf, .html and Markdown, exports text, EPUB and tagged PDF, and reads Word 97 .doc.
Reviews with comments, suggesting mode, compare and combine, named versions and live co-editing.
Runs every command from a terminal, so an agent can drive the open document.

facts.dd: .ftxt, a zip of document.json and media/
TypeScript and ProseMirror with its own page layout
Python 3.12 and FastAPI, which owns the .ftxt model, exchange and exports
Stored in ~/FormTxt by default; both servers listen on this computer only

chapters.title: Real pages, or no pages at all
chapters.text: Documents lay out on pages with paper size, orientation and margins from Page setup, line-by-line splitting with widow and orphan control, headers and footers, section breaks and a ruler. A pageless mode and zoom from 25 to 300 percent are one click away.

chapters.title: A ribbon and a home screen
chapters.text: Tabs for Home, Insert, Draw, Design, Layout, References, Mailings, Review, View, AI and Help, with contextual tabs for tables, pictures, shapes and charts. Home offers Start, Recent documents and 39 original templates in 11 categories.

chapters.title: Comments, suggestions and Word round trips
chapters.text: Word files keep comments with replies, tracked changes, bookmarks, real fields, content controls and the table of contents. Suggesting mode tracks every edit, including paragraph formatting.

features.title: Home
features.text: Start, Recent documents, templates and a Trash.
bullets: Open a file, a blank document, a dropzone for Markdown and text files, or Paste text
39 original templates in 11 categories with search and preview
Recent documents can be pinned, duplicated, saved as a template or deleted with Undo
Trash with restore and permanent delete

features.title: Editor
features.text: Styles, fonts and the usual formatting, with Markdown-style shortcuts.
bullets: Normal, Title, Subtitle, Quote and Heading 1 to 9
Lists with nine levels, links, code blocks, find and replace with regular expressions
Format Painter and a style editor
Word and Google Docs keyboard shortcuts, rebindable with Ctrl+/
Find a Command (Ctrl+Shift+P)

features.title: Pages and layout
features.text: Real pagination with a ruler and section control.
bullets: Headers and footers with page numbers in five formats
Different first page and odd and even pages
Page colour, page borders, a watermark and a cover page
Print layout, Draft, Read mode and Focus mode views
Section breaks with their own headers and numbering

features.title: Tables and pictures
features.text: Tables with merge and split, repeating header rows and table styles.
bullets: Convert text separated by tabs, commas, semicolons or pipes to a table and back
Markdown pipe tables open as tables
Long tables split between rows across pages
Pictures in PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and more

features.title: References
features.text: Long-document tools for reports and papers.
bullets: Table of contents, footnotes and endnotes
Citations in eight source types with a bibliography
Captions, cross-references, an index and bookmarks

features.title: Review and versions
bullets: Comments with reactions
Suggesting mode with accept and reject
Compare and combine, tables cell by cell
Named versions and recovery, protection and passwords
Approvals, fields and content controls

features.title: Mailings and sharing
features.text: Mail merge, envelopes and labels, and live co-editing.
bullets: Signature line
Autosave to WebDAV cloud storage
Live co-editing with presence
Share links on this computer or network, and publish

features.title: Files and print
features.text: Open and save the common document formats.
bullets: .docx, .dotx, .odt, .rtf, .html and Markdown
Export text and EPUB, read Word 97 .doc
Print preview, ranges and copies, tagged PDF export
Open a PDF, with OCR for scanned pages

features.title: Proofing
features.text: Its own spelling and grammar and an Editor panel.
bullets: Clarity, formality, inclusiveness and vocabulary checks
AutoCorrect, a thesaurus and dictionary, hyphenation
Right-to-left text, read aloud and dictation
An accessibility checker

features.title: AI with your own key
features.text: Drafting and editing through a provider key you supply.
bullets: Drafting, rewrite and summaries that stay current
Document edits as tracked suggestions
Translation, image options and an audio overview

features.title: Ribbon and preferences
features.text: Ribbon layout since 0.28.0 with galleries filled in by 0.29.0.
bullets: Quick Access Toolbar and command search (Alt+Q)
Alt key tips, Customize Ribbon, simplified, tabs-only and icons-only displays
Preferences (Ctrl+,) with 29 themes
View > Dark Page shows the page dark without changing printing or exports

features.title: Commands and agents
features.text: Every command also runs from a terminal.
bullets: ./formtxt cli list shows the command catalogue
./formtxt cli run tools.stats
./formtxt cli run edit.replaceAll find=draft replace=final

parity.summary: Of the 196 capabilities graded, FormTxt 0.29.6 is full on 180, partial on 13 and has nothing for 3. Every FormTxt cell was traced in code; LibreOffice Writer is the other column. What stays partial needs accounts for share links and signatures, a public server, recorded-audio transcription and screen reader checks.

docs.agents: Claude Code, Codex or Cursor work on the open document through the same commands, which also run from ./formtxt cli run.

topics.title: Stack and ports
topics.text: The app runs on http://localhost:5210 and the engine on 127.0.0.1:8210; FORMTXT_UI_PORT, FORMTXT_ENGINE_PORT and FORMTXT_DATA_DIR override them.

topics.title: Keyboard and commands
topics.text: Find a Command (Ctrl+Shift+P), command search (Alt+Q) and rebindable shortcuts (Ctrl+/) reach every command.

topics.title: File format
topics.text: .ftxt is a zip of document.json and media/; the contract is docs/FORMAT.md.

topics.title: Desktop app
topics.text: ./build_app makes FormTxt.app and a disk image on macOS, a .deb on Linux and MSI and NSIS installers with build_app.bat on Windows.

topics.title: Parity
topics.text: The FormTxt page of the FormAI Parity Tracker lists the 199 Word and Google Docs capabilities in the research baseline, each with its vendor source.

items: The desktop window's scripts keep their types on Windows, fixing a blank window
Linux packages pull in the media plugins
The macOS engine is signed for notarization
Windows scripts are checked out with CRLF
.ftxt files open through both import routes
The splash logo no longer moves when its line and bar arrive
Test and window jobs added to CI
